name: player_is_mission_probe_type1_enabled_by_id
description: Player::IsMissionProbeType1EnabledById returns whether a mission id enables probe type 1 player behavior.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player/GameNet source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x423380 validates ECX as the mission id, immediate true returns for ids 9, 11, and 12, and a final sete true return only for id 13.
The native smoke verifies all accepted mission ids plus adjacent and negative rejected ids.
